title: Enhancing source water quality predictions to improve treatment by integrating watershed data on water quality, river flow and rainfall into interpretable machine learning algorithms
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00235H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Christian Ortiz-Lopez, Christian Bouchard, Manuel J. Rodriguez
Rainfall and river flow affect raw water quality, and ML models like XGBoost can predict turbidity using upstream data. Integrating upstream turbidity improves predictions and helps operators adjust treatment processes.
